uk.s: ELSA Futures Carnival · Trade & Win Up to 2,130 USDT!
The ELSA Futures Carnival is officially live! Trade ELSAUSDT Perpetual Futures, complete campaign tasks, and unlock tiered rewards worth up to 2,130 USDT.
Trade ELSAUSDT Perpetual Futures, reach trading volume milestones, complete campaign tasks, and earn more rewards throughout the campaign.
ELSA Futures Trading Milestone: Up to 2,020 USDT
Complete campaign tasks and tradeELSAUSDT Perpetual Futures during the campaign.
Trade ELSAUSDT Perpetual Futures during the campaign. Cumulative trading volume includes both opening and closing orders, as well as Long and Short positions.

Complete campaign tasks to earn additional rewards, including Cumulative Deposit Tasks, First ELSAUSDT Futures Trade, and Invite Friends.
